row.notes: Builds the first 3D driver model of the MyTeam driver market / contract comparison screen. Gets the entrant pointer list through vfunc +0x1c8 of (+0x6b8)+0x1030, keeps entrants whose team id (+0x58 byte, +0x5a short) matches the screen team id at +0x6c0, sorts with Ne_Std_IntroSort_PtrsByOptByte80 and trims to 2, then picks index 0 or (when +0x2dc0 is set) the int at +0x2a78. Fills a custom-driver descriptor from entrant +0x50/+0x54/+0x58 with a random name string (LCG on (+0x2d70)+0x188), allocates slot +0x2d46 via Game_FrontendSceneManager_FindOrCreateNewCustomDriver(+0x2d58). If +0x2dc0==0 it uses scene node Driver1 with pose_07_idle (kind 4) through Ui_Setup_DriverFrontendForPerkAcclaim, else DriverMarketDriver1 with pose_07_idle (kind 3/7) through Game_FrontendSceneManager_SetupCustomDriver. Independent re-check (lab blind verifier 2026-11-27): agree.
